sinopsis.es: Somorrostro en tres actes mezcla tres tiempos y tres formatos cinematográficos para tratar de reflejar los cambios operados en la ciudad de Barcelona en los últimos sesenta años, así como captar la transformación de las formas de filmar.
sinopsis.en: Through three different moments, between the sixties, the nineties and the present, the director portrays an emblematic place in Barcelona that has gone from being a marginal corner to becoming one of the epicenters of mass tourism. Somorrostro, now the beach, before the neighborhood, is the object of this dialogue between archival and current images that is also the reunion, between frames, of a granddaughter with her grandfather.
